method: Each page-1.png through page-10.png opened through view_image; textual content and OOXML independently inspected against BB Reports source.

qPCR QC caveats, statistical methods, descriptive archives and biochemical numerical results readable; no missing symbols.
qPCR exact adjusted P values and nonsignificant comparison preserved; discussion and major limits clear; no layout defects.

Alphabetical author-year reference list and DOI strings readable; no overflow.
Figure1/2 captions, sampling times/adjustment families, explanatory units and SI captions readable; gene italic preserved.
